title: Watercolor 128 Silver Laurel Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 8 amenity access bands.**- Unsurpassed central location for all Watercolor & Seaside attractions- 3rd floor cupola/lookout with 360 panoramic views - 2 blocks to the beach and ocean beach club- 2 blocks to freshwater kayaking, fishing, pool and boathouse on inland waterway- 4 pools within 2 blocks- 2 1/2 blocks by shaded path to Seaside shops and restaurants- 3 blocks to award-winning tennis and pickleball courts- 5 minutes by bike to lazy river, slide, basketball, playgrounds and grass sports field at Camp Watercolor- 70 inch HD TV in main room- 4 lovely private outdoor terraces, including one off the primary bedroom- 1,000 square feet of outdoor living space + unique outdoor shower- 3 adult bikes- 2 dedicated covered parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout**NEWLY REMODELED FOR 2025 with over 200 square feet of additional interior living space, including a new third-story 9 by 16-foot cupola and exterior third-story deck, with panoramic views of Watercolor, and an all new first-floor office suite. The remodel includes a new outdoor shower and a doubling of the rear deck size!-Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: 128 Silver Laurel Way is an adorable home ideally located within the Park District of WaterColor that feels secluded and quiet while also being convenient to WaterColor's many amenities and just a short walk to the beach. Decorated by a published, award-winning designer and boasting 1,000 SF of outdoor living space, including screened porches, this home is well-suited for families or couples. On the first floor is the living area, with furnishings and finishes that create a relaxing gathering space. Cook a meal in the home's well-stocked kitchen and enjoy eating with your family and friends in the dining area. Read a book or sip your morning cup of coffee in the additional sitting area, right off the kitchen. The second floor features the home's three bedrooms, including a primary bedroom retreat, each with its own en-suite bathroom. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:-Half Bath With Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin over Queen Bunk, Day Bed with Twin Trundle, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:-Other Sleeping Arrangement: Lofted Twin bed in Office RoomWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside diningWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Per HOA Policy, all Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one Low-Speed Vehicle per home. Homes with owner provided Low-Speed Vehicles are not permitted to rent an additional Low-Speed Vehicle.
